tasks.notes:
Crash Mode engagement ideas (vehicle crash/destruction game; best avg session time, goal: more playtime and return visits):
1. Daily login streak: escalating rewards (cash, crates, a day-7 exclusive car or paint), with a streak-freeze item so one missed day doesn't reset it.
2. Daily/weekly destruction challenges: e.g. "Cause $50k damage in one run", "Flip 10 times", "Crash at 150+ mph", each paying currency/XP; 3 daily + 1 weekly.
3. Leaderboards: global and friends boards for biggest single crash, total damage, longest airtime, most flips; daily/weekly resets, top players get a badge or podium spot in the lobby.
4. Vehicle unlock and upgrade tree: progress from beaters to trucks, buses, monster trucks, rocket cars; upgrades for speed, mass, and crumple/explosion effects, with a visible next-unlock bar.
5. Limited-time events and rotating maps: weekend 2x-damage, Halloween pumpkin-smash map, Mega Ramp week, meteor-shower mode; event-only cosmetics to drive return visits.
6. Party/squad crash modes: queue with friends, chain-reaction pileups, team demolition derby, last-car-standing rounds, with a friend-join bonus and a private-server option.
7. Slow-motion replay and share: auto-capture the best crash with a slow-mo cam and a "Best Crash" card to screenshot, plus a lobby highlight board of the server's top crash.
8. Collectibles and achievements: hidden collectibles on each map, badges for milestones (first 1M damage, all cars), a garage trophy wall.
9. UGC and customization: paints, decals, wheels, horns, crash-trail effects; sell or promote UGC accessories themed on the game, and possibly let players build and share ramp/obstacle courses.
10. Server-wide goals and quick sessions: a community damage meter that triggers a server-wide reward (meteor storm, 2x cash) when filled, and timed 3-minute crash rounds that end on a 'one more run' rewards screen.
